coordinates
module and implementation revision, owned law, operator or function family, module state, input class, boundary class, expected relation, generated case, mutation, and result identity
governing invariants
`DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` module ownership and unit-proof law; accepted Ontology, IACS, domain, sequence, state, algorithm, and error relations material to the module
authority
bounded local evidence only; a unit result has no Product, installed, integration, user-acceptance, architecture, path-selection, or release authority
evidence

law-derived examples, equivalence classes, finite exhaustive cases where available, property-based or generative cases, metamorphic relations, calculation or algebra oracles, boundary cases, and killed internal mutations
capability envelope
competence to derive an oracle independently from the owned law, identify the module-bounded combination population, and distinguish invariant violation from implementation restatement
exclusions

Product outcomes, cross-module composition, supported user paths, packaging or installation, real external participants, orchestration topology, mocked-away interface behavior, incidental branches, private helper layout, assertion count, and source coverage used as broader assurance
result
one Reference Frame Method result limited to the exact module-owned law and module-bounded population, with counterexamples, residual combinations, and invalidation conditions
invalidation
material Ontology, IACS, module boundary, owned law, algorithm, state space, numerical regime, implementation, oracle, generator, or module-bounded population change

determinations.source_excerpt:
Executive attention is event-driven by default. Re-enter the attention cycle
for a decision-relevant closed result, material exception or changed basis,
owner request, or declared deadline or checkpoint. While Workers carry out
their bounded grants and no other authorized decision is ready, wait. Do not
repeatedly inspect unfinished work, replay unchanged judgments, or request
status without a decision need.

definition.meaning: The profile coordination frame selecting bounded configuration and consuming closed results under existing decision authority for long-term delivery.
definition.limits: Its sufficient bounded delivery view covers outcome, mandate, unresolved obligations, dependencies and exact results; durable workspace holds the frontier. It is not a universal semantic owner, controller/service or runtime observer.

determinations.applicability: Interpreting this profile term in an admitted engagement.

inputs.description: Bounded direct-human or proxy decision authority and material delivery frontier.
inputs.required_when: Interpreting this profile term in an admitted engagement.

determinations.predicate: Executive maintains a sufficient bounded current delivery view, activates the smallest dependency-ready capable set, consumes closed results, and selects only action already within its decision grant without performing implementation effects.
obligations: Maintain outcome/basis, Product roles, evaluation inventory, dependencies, unresolved frontier, actor envelopes, mandate, triage policy and residuals.
Keep assurance-independent activations free from unclosed peer results; apply only declared conjunctions/translations and update affected support on change.
No candidate, Product or worktree mutation while Executive; a same-actor Worker/Writer transition is explicitly recorded with exact operation grant before effect.
End the attention loop only with every mandatory evaluation closed, governing-authority retention of claim-compatible residuals, or an applicable stop retaining all remaining obligations.
A closed falsification or stopped cycle does not satisfy Product outcome. Preserve stop predicate/cause, performance and effects.
If coordination itself does not fit, refine, obtain bounded evaluation or stop; never drop a material dependency.
Keep Reviewer severity, Executive priority, boundary effect, disposition and subsequent action distinct.
Return through declared D relations; lateral handoff, child completion, tool output and common actor identity supply no activation or continuation authority.

Derive U0 from applicable obligations and dependencies rather than visible returns; select M after supporting dependencies. Missing results, unknown applicability and uncertain material effects remain in the durable frontier while independent work may proceed under its own sufficient grant and evidence.
permissions_exceptions: Ready activations may run in parallel; no scheduler/frame-engine implementation is required.
Valid closed results and source routes replace loading private evaluator context; recovery can reconstruct the delivery view from durable workspace.

Executive is the profile frame for three inseparable duties over one governed
outcome:
determinations.applicability: An activated coordinated delivery decision over one governed outcome.

inputs.description: Current outcome, mandate, Product-role map, frontier, dependencies and actor envelopes.
inputs.required_when: An activated coordinated delivery decision over one governed outcome.

inputs.description: Exact returned results, invalidators, original evidence and delegated decision/operation boundaries.

determinations.predicate: The proposed action/reliance preserves the current outcome, exact basis, distinct Product roles, existing grants and material coverage/return relations.
obligations: Outcome lock: Goal, Product outcome, boundary, re-entry class, mandate and triage policy remain selected.
Basis lock: subject, authority, dependency, configuration, topology, evidence, time and candidate remain exact/current.
Product-role lock: Source Project, Product Definition, Release Cut, Product, Install, Artifact and dependent Product remain distinct; each Development Product binds its exact Install.
Authority lock: semantic, evaluation, operation, decision, acceptance and publication grants remain unchanged.
Coverage/return lock: material evaluations/interactions are closed or explicit residual and consumed results use their declared return relation.
Changed meaning re-enters its owner; activation admission and downstream work predicates stay distinct.
permissions_exceptions: The locks bind the shared application contract rather than requiring a second ledger or enlarging authority.

owned_relation_rows: Contract sufficiency

Can each participant determine and perform its responsibility from the declared interface and available context? Source-grounded design evaluation may establish this claim without an implemented runtime; unresolved realizability or actor-context questions remain explicit.
Boundary congruence

Do the actual selected producers, transformations and consumers preserve the declared domains, meanings, lifecycle and authority? Acquire both sides and their exchanges for an actual-composition claim; design correspondence alone does not prove implementation behavior.
Path realization
Does the exact runnable subject use the authoritative entry-to-outcome path through its material state, effect and observation boundaries? Matching output through another path is insufficient.
User usability

Can the ordinary human, LLM or software caller obtain the selected outcome using only its declared context, access and supported surface? Internal success or validator-aware fixtures cannot establish this claim.

determinations.source_excerpt:
Reuse existing truth surfaces. The working record adds only missing
cross-interface relations; schemas, prompts, adapters, indexes and tests do
not become another contract owner. For each material seam:
determinations.applicability: Applying this profile to each material interface seam and its applicable claims.

owned_numbered_conditions.condition: Bind the functional input domain, producer success postconditions, consumer preconditions, permitted effects, refusals and observable exit. Direct successful handoff requires the producer guarantees to meet the consumer preconditions. An interface may instead emit candidates: candidate output, later admission and semantic assessment remain distinct declared stages. A normal model refusal or inadmissible candidate does not by itself falsify an adequately declared candidate interface; evaluate the exact promised outcome and refusal behavior.

Make material actor obligations and domains available through the actual interface/context or an exact locator the actor can lawfully resolve. Bind the LLM role, instructions, supplied context, tools and model/transport configuration where material. Generic governance access does not replace the Product-specific contract or authorize inference of hidden validator rules. Existing deterministic owners compute available facts and expose their owned relation to context and validation through reuse or proven equivalent projections. Semantic actors judge meaning within that domain; reserved owner rulings, eligibility, authority and admission are not inferred from an actor response or frame label.

Apply [Faithful projection](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md#faithful-projection) across serialization, parsing, normalization and adaptation. Bind producer and consumer contracts as the source/target meanings, preserving domain and temporal distinctions: proposed, admitted, assessed and completed; active input and historical context; current validity and byte availability.

Apply [Workspace and context](FOUNDATIONS.md#workspace-and-context) to the mutable subject of each later operation. Its observation is distinct from immutable authority, artifacts, history and prior candidates. For an ordinary real-path claim, a pre-step snapshot does not replace the actual current subject that the later operation must observe. This restriction on the mutable operational subject does not change an explicitly frozen authority or artifact basis or require repeating valid work merely because the actor changes.

Follow the actual callable path and existing effect owners through the selected exit and any required fresh observation. Hidden fallback, state injection, manually repaired output, private entry or undeclared retry cannot support an ordinary real-path claim. A pure function acquires no new event lifecycle merely because this frame evaluates it.

Preserve diagnostic cause through wrappers and projections. Apply [Counterexample Localization](#counterexample-localization): report the supported causal frontier, not merely the first log or clock occurrence. Retain the originating seam, bounded field/path, expected domain or basis, observed mismatch and evidence locator where available, plus downstream symptoms, successful work and declared continuation or block. Preserve joint causes, alternative frontiers and indeterminacy; do not invent a unique cause. Product redaction rules still govern sensitive content. Missing required diagnostic evidence remains a named gap. Return the smallest supported owner/re-entry; diagnosis grants no repair or retry.

trial, universal test quota or whole-Product qualification. Each selected

owned_relation_rows: Empty and nonempty eligible domains

Ordinary context makes both domains usable; a universal empty-value workaround cannot replace the governing domain. A hidden required rule defeats contract sufficiency even if the validator correctly refuses.
Adequate candidate contract and rejected response
Distinguish legitimate refusal/admission filtering from an inadequate interface or a violated success guarantee; model variability alone is not frame failure.
Same-response or historical-only reference
Eligibility and lifecycle come from the owning domain; available or equal-looking references are not automatically current admissible inputs.
Individually valid but temporally mismatched carriers
Different observations or admission states can falsify boundary congruence despite matching shapes.
Meaning-changing translation
Loss of units, default, identity or ordering is detected against the independent outcome oracle, even when both shapes validate.
Fixture knows a hidden rule
Mechanical success leaves user usability unproved; it cannot conceal missing ordinary actor context.
Expected output through a forbidden path
Path realization is falsified; output equality does not discharge the actual-path obligation.
Changed workspace and reusable accepted work
Refresh affected context and dependent evidence while preserving unaffected valid work; history does not substitute for the current subject.
Wrapped or ambiguous failure
Preserve the supported originating causal frontier and uncertainty without replacing it with a downstream symptom or an invented unique cause.
Design-only sufficient contract
A bounded contract result can close while runtime and user claims remain unclaimed or unresolved according to their applicability; no runtime/UAT satisfaction is inferred.

The [F1, F4, F5 and F6 premises](FOUNDATIONS.md#foundational-commitments), applied
through [Configuration](FOUNDATIONS.md#configuration), require sufficient task
allocation that preserves the outcome, material dependencies, capability limits
and grants. When an adopting Product requires independent assurance, its
assurance owner adds that independence premise. These premises constrain the
Executive, Worker and Reviewer contracts below; they do not force three roles.
This profile chooses their labels, return flow, Executive mutation exclusion
and event-driven attention policy. Existing Product authority chooses adoption,
direct versus coordinated activation and actual grants.

Qualification of this derived profile applies `REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md`
Frame Qualification and `STDO-UP-022`; it does not create another qualification

determinations.applicability: Qualifying this adopted profile and its declared composition with the exact Frame Method.

owned_numbered_conditions.condition: existing project authority selects and projects the frame configuration;
a known incapable or unauthorized actor produces an activation refusal and no Worker result;
a fresh capable Worker reconstructs its intake without hidden conversation history;

every effectful Worker activation carries its exact inherited operation grant, subject, and write territory; an in-territory mutation succeeds only under that exact grant and an out-of-territory mutation refuses, without granting operation authority to another frame;

each qualified `(Worker work-result variant, cause)` maps to exactly one core verdict on the [Work result](#work-result) availability predicate, including missing-reason handling, and returns to its declared consumer, Executive in the coordinated branch; several cases may map to one verdict, so the original variant and cause remain required;

a sufficient direct local case starts and finishes as Writer in its existing carrier without Executive appointment or independent review; a coordinated `candidate_ready` also reaches disposition without Reviewer activation when independent review is not required;
review-required `candidate_ready` causes Executive, not Worker, to activate Reviewer;
Reviewer reacquires the exact subject and live production and assurance surfaces material to its claim;
changed candidate or basis invalidates the affected review result;
Worker self-review, Reviewer evaluation, Executive decision authority, and `STDO-UP-020` disposition remain distinguishable;
missing-frame pressure triggers bounded diagnosis or lawful re-entry;

a supported-surface user scenario binds one exact user, deployed, installed, or otherwise runnable Product form, configuration, ordinary path, and Product outcome without hidden capability or test-only entry;
the corresponding end-to-end frame observes the authoritative runnable causal path and falsifies equal output obtained through a forbidden path;
integration trials vary the material participant interaction dimensions and retain omitted higher-order combinations as residuals;

every coded module has a module-derived unit lane, and unit trials use evidence size and strategy proportional to the internal combinatorial complexity of the module-owned law while remaining unable to establish an integration, runnable-Product, user, or Product claim;
disabling the selected path or forcing a rival path produces the declared failure or refusal without mutating the assurance subject undetectably;
aggregate green status cannot hide a missing, conflicted, stale-subject, or wrong-path testing-frame result;
owner-issued runtime truth is acquired through the exact owner surface and evaluated with a separately derived oracle, while generic assurance mechanics remain authority-neutral;
a counterexample returns a causally minimal supported frontier represented as one unique locus, a jointly established incomparable set, unresolved alternative frontiers, or `indeterminate` evidence;
a project-defined configuration can replace the profile without changing the selected STDO law or inventing another authority layer;

every generic specialist-frame family is instantiated where material, evidenced as non-material by capable authority, or retained as an explicit residual rather than omitted by artifact or component absence;

a representative multi-frame claim refuses or returns non-satisfaction when an identity, coordinate, value/evidence, lifecycle, authority, or provenance seam is missing, stale, foreign, or non-commuting; and
the generic specialist set can be instantiated without importing a consumer-specific architecture, runtime object, or renamed local topology into the baseline;
Reviewer returns evidence-bound severity and technical implications while remaining unable to assign priority, block promotion, direct repair, or activate another frame;

Executive consumes the exact technical triage with the complete Product view and current MVP or release mandate, keeps severity, priority, frame result, and promotion-boundary effect distinct, and selects only an authorized disposition and action; and
a finding outside the exact claim boundary remains repricing input rather than creating a release block or another review round by severity label.

The Reviewer payload projection is total across the shared core verdicts as
bound by RF-012. `complete`, `indeterminate`, and `not_applicable` below classify
the finding-level triage payload; they are not new evaluation results,
dispositions, priorities, or lifecycle states.
determinations.applicability: Projecting any of the five core review verdicts to a finding/triage payload and consumer constraints.

owned_relation_rows: `satisfied`
explicit no-finding state; triage `not_applicable`; evidence, residuals, and invalidation remain present
priority and current-boundary effect are `not_applicable` to this review result unless another exact consumed result supplies a finding
`falsified`
one or more exact findings; triage is `complete` where supported and preserves `indeterminate` fields where evidence cannot close them
apply Product-owned priority and boundary policy without mechanically mapping severity to disposition
`indeterminate`
partial finding or observation state; triage `indeterminate`; exact evidence gaps and residual uncertainty
retain uncertainty or reactivate a capable evaluation; do not consume it as satisfaction or a closed finding
`out_of_frame`
the evaluated claim requires an undeclared material relation or evaluator capability; triage `indeterminate`; name the missing relation or capability and exact reconfiguration pressure
refine or reconfigure a capable activation and retain the claim as unresolved; do not consume the result as satisfaction or falsification
`invalid_basis`
basis failure; triage `not_applicable`; invalidation evidence and basis-repair pressure
refuse result consumption and return through the declared basis re-entry relation

determinations.source_excerpt:
Executive sequences delivery around a steel thread: the smallest real,
runnable path from a supported Product entry to a material outcome through
the selected composition. Establish that path early and expand it in bounded
increments. Where it already exists, extend or revalidate the affected
thread. Select increments by consequential uncertainty, dependency and
interface reach, and failure impact.

determinations.family: Technical triage, severity, priority, and boundary effect
determinations.predicate: Reviewer supplies supported claim-relative technical severity and implications; Executive separately assigns priority, boundary effect and an existing disposition under Product-selected policy and its own grant.
obligations: Triage binds affected claim/failure, Product severity scale, causal assessment/confidence, blast radius/users/paths, workaround/containment, repair complexity/regression/dependencies and unresolved evidence.
Missing cause or repair evidence remains explicit; a material missing relation/capability yields the applicable indeterminate/out-of-frame pressure without invented precision or lateral repair.
Severity grades consequence; priority orders response by full outcome, likelihood/exposure, mandate, reversibility, dependencies, delay cost and capacity.
Product frame basis owns severity/priority scales, cutoff and non-waivable stops; no universal numeric scale.
Priority cannot waive a hard stop or falsified mandatory claim, and severity outside the exact claim does not add review rounds.
The three boundary effects (blocks, requires narrowing, may remain an explicit residual) are decisions, not candidate-fitness verdicts.
permissions_exceptions: A lawful blocks decision can satisfy its own mandate predicate while the candidate claim is falsified.

result_mapping.decision_predicate: This boundary-effect determination for this finding and exact promotion boundary was made under the current Product mandate by its bound authority.

decision_map.falsified: Mandate, grant or hard-stop violation established.

determinations.source_excerpt:
Under [F2 and F6](FOUNDATIONS.md#foundational-commitments), evidence about a
failure does not supply a grant to select its response. Given this profile's
Reviewer/Executive separation, severity and authorized priority therefore remain
distinct. This profile chooses that allocation and the triage fields below;
Product authority separately chooses scales, cutoffs and non-waivable stops.

inputs.description: Exact finding and admissible causal/impact evidence.

determinations.predicate: Each test claim retains its own subject, basis and evidence altitude; only declared frame relations combine them, and no broader or narrower green result hides missing, conflicting or wrong-subject required evidence.
obligations: UAT owns user-outcome evidence, E2E the complete authoritative runnable path, integration actual participant composition and unit module-owned laws.
UAT alone can leave path singularity open; E2E can leave user populations/combinations open; integration/unit cannot replace either broader claim.
When all are required, conflicts or missing results remain visible to disposition.
permissions_exceptions: One execution may contribute multiple separately bound results, including an internal unit counterexample from a broader scenario.

definition.meaning: A specialist frame executing or observing a declared subject to discriminate one exact claim through an explicit oracle, population, path and falsification condition.
definition.limits: File, suite, runner, fixture, scenario label or actor presence is insufficient. Counts, coverage percentages, time and runner category cannot widen evidence scope.

determinations.predicate: The requested candidate and transition evidence are available on the activated basis within the admitted grant bounds, including a delivery time only where the grant requires it.
obligations: Preserve original work variant and cause, exact availability predicate, performance, material effects, evidence, unresolved obligations and citations.
Map candidate_ready only when availability and all declared bounds are established; never infer fitness, admission, acceptance or publication.
Distinguish incomplete-undecided from observed missing delivery, missed bound or missing transition evidence.
Cause distinguishes outside-frame from invalid-basis re-entry; missing required cause supplies no deciding support.
Known capability/authority/staleness/ambiguity/topology mismatch at activation is activation_refusal and creates no Worker activation/result.
Refusal names reason/authority; incomplete names stop basis; re-entry names material relation/owner.
Reference current computed classification, judgments and owner rulings through existing carriers; revise affected support only and preserve originals.
permissions_exceptions: Consumers choose serialization/carrier; exact source contracts decide.
Independent admissible counterevidence or scope/basis diagnosis on the same predicate remains usable despite an unsupported variant.
Later delivery under changed bounds is a successor claim, not repair of the original missed bound.

determinations.source_excerpt:
A **work result** is the closed Worker output to its declared consumer; in the
coordinated branch that consumer is Executive. It exists only after successful
Worker activation. An `activation_refusal` returns to the assigning authority
or declared result carrier and creates neither a Worker activation nor a
Worker result.
determinations.applicability: Returning completed bounded work after successful Worker activation.

owned_relation_rows: `candidate_ready`
the bound availability predicate is established, including its declared bounds
`satisfied`
`refused`
an established governing prohibition or owner-valid refusal defeats the bound availability predicate after lawful activation
`falsified`
`incomplete`, `undecided`
admissible evidence or unfinished bounded work cannot establish the bound availability predicate
`indeterminate`
`incomplete`, `postcondition_defeated`
an observed missing delivery, missed declared bound or missing required transition evidence defeats the bound availability predicate
`falsified`
`re_entry_requested`, `outside_frame`
a material relation, decision or capability needed to establish the claim lies outside the activated frame
`out_of_frame`
`re_entry_requested`, `basis_invalid`
the activated subject or basis cannot support the claim
`invalid_basis`
any variant lacking its required cause or its row's evidence condition
retain the raw outcome without inventing deciding support; independently admissible evidence on the same bound predicate remains available
apply the core missing-reason rule; the unsupported label supplies no verdict

determinations.predicate: Required independent assessment is by a nonauthor of the reviewed subject, bound to exact subject/basis/scope/exclusions/evidence/verdict/unresolved findings with durable trace. Authoring authority, useful self-review and human acceptance do not establish independence.
obligations: Promotion/closure reliance needs the actual durable exact review verdict, not a statement, unbound summary or unavailable draft.

A finding blocks current promotion only if it falsifies the bounded claim, exposes competing/ambiguous acceptance authority, violates active authority/safety/retained accepted behavior, or establishes durable architecture foreclosing an admitted Product outcome.
Record direct/lawfully proxied human rulings before the next affected acceptance boundary with source wording separate from interpretation; opening a ticket alone does not satisfy the ruling.
Under UP-020 bind selected basis, affected relation, construction/assessment authority and re-entry; ticket/admission cannot widen it or replace live-surface assessment.
permissions_exceptions: Independent review is not mandated for every local step.
Outside-boundary findings remain repricing input and alone create no wider subject/blocker/ticket/artifact/review/increment.
Existing ticket/comment/commit/qualification/release evidence suffices; no new carrier or ceremony required.

result_mapping.conditions: Blocks-promotion/repricing-input classify relevance, not claim verdict. Evaluate actual promotion gate: known violated gate falsifies; unknown required evidence is indeterminate with scope/basis/coverage preserved. An outside-boundary finding does not establish satisfaction.

argument.conditional_consequence: Given an adopted work contract, scope, evidence, authority and preserved obligations determine lawful execution and closure. Ticket/sprint carriers, workflow labels, admission and migration policies are local method choices, not deductions from finitude.
policy_choices: Required independent assessment is by a nonauthor of the reviewed subject, bound to exact subject/basis/scope/exclusions/evidence/verdict/unresolved findings with durable trace. Authoring authority, useful self-review and human acceptance do not establish independence.

independence. UP-007 chooses its applicable boundaries, durable trace and

determinations.source_excerpt:
This work-carrier member binds the shared [transformation library](TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY.md)
to durable work identity, admission, recording and closure. Given finite actor
context and obligations that may outlive it, continuing work needs a recoverable
source independent of private memory. The
[workspace/context relation](FOUNDATIONS.md#workspace-and-context) supplies that
requirement; Work-Carrier-To-Execution chooses the smallest carrier for its
actual lifetime. Tickets, sprints and the default file layout are this member's
additional policy, not universal consequences of finite capacity. Admission and
closure consume the shared [result algebra](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-algebra) and
[conjunction](FOUNDATIONS.md#result-conjunction) at their deciding boundaries.
The bindings below preserve core performance, coverage, diagnostic precedence
and actual effects. They add no evaluation pass or record to the existing work.

The premise applies when work needs independent state beyond the local boundary; a ticket or particular physical file is not required for every execution.

instance_premises: The adopting Product selects one exact calculus basis and a compatible occurrence signature.
The external subject can change while retaining a stable subject binding.
Each effect is a separately identified operation requiring its actual owner-issued grant.
argument.conditional_consequence: Each authored source-family row below states the consequence and additional choice for its named consumers; the rows do not add a Boolean gate or confer a grant.
policy_choices: This profile closes its sorts, reference domains, event/relation kinds and qualifiers. The Product declares its interpretation, concrete authorities and compatible signature; absent or incomplete adoption leaves the profile inactive.

This profile chooses immutable occurrences/events and append-only correction. A new application mints a new occurrence; the Product supplies subject interpretation and correction authority. Those choices imply neither effect idempotence nor rollback.
This profile chooses separate identity and causal DAGs. The Product owns admitted causal claims and its explicit precedence law; neither timestamps nor common actors supply those relations.

This profile chooses the seven-member cut, three admitted judgments and whole-unit admission. Its exact equality and membership conditions bind core conjunction; semantic atomicity prescribes no storage transaction.

This profile chooses `SubjectBinding`, exact grant joins, pre/post observations and the closed disposition/readiness relations. Product-owned containment may replace territory equality only as declared. Shared currentness and effect law decide dependent repetition; the profile supplies no lock, rollback or scheduler.

This profile chooses immutable `EventFrontier` and projection identities with explicit precedence, boundaries and residuals. The Product supplies event-scope and projection laws; the shared faithful-projection contract evaluates that exact relation.

Invocation operation matches exact object; operation_of_kind/targets_subject/authorized_by mirror fields; operation, grant and occurrence subject match; kind belongs to allowed kinds; instance contract equals exact kind contract; territory equals invocation and allowed territory.
Same-labelled different contract/target-sort/invalidated or unresolved kind fails grant. Nominal label, executor access or broad workspace access is insufficient.

Readiness immediately before effect requires current pre-observation and grant under declared invalidation; stale or unauthorized does not dispatch. Re-observe with a new readiness subject/judgment or stop.
invokes_effect exists iff actually dispatched. Invocation contains no future disposition; later disposition does not rewrite it.

no_effect has no dispatched invocation and records no attempt; not_requested requires established effect-free scope, while requested stopped-before-dispatch needs authenticated non-dispatch to map not_started. Missing support leaves disposition unadmitted and effect unknown.
refused_effect binds refused attempt, refusal stop and evidence no mutation began; maps not_started only with that evidence.
completed_effect requires dispatched invocation, bounded post-observation and sufficient evidence; maps completed without implying intended outcome satisfaction.

partial_effect requires dispatched invocation, post-observation, bounded evidence, partial_effect residual/stop and explicit re-entry before further effect. Core actual effect may be partial/reverted/unknown under all material parts, preserving irreversible effects and reversals.
Lost dispatch response without observation cannot manufacture no/refused/completed effect. Missing post-observation remains residual; observe before dependent action or repeat.
Unauthorized mutation remains actual effect; lack of permission never proves no-start or hides observed/uncertain mutation.
permissions_exceptions: Product compatible signature may replace exact territory equality only with explicit authority-owned containment law.
No required lock, transaction, snapshot or rollback implementation.

determinations.source_excerpt: `UX_METHOD.md` adopts the **Elm Architecture** as the constitutional UX process model and refines `DESIGN_MODULE_METHOD.md` for UX surfaces. The model: typed `State` held by the runtime, typed `Msg` algebra, pure `Update : (Msg, State) → (State, Cmd)`, pure `View : State → ViewTree`, side effects as `Cmd` values interpreted at a declared effect membrane that returns `Msg` to the reducer. The view does not own continuation (UX twin of `ODD_METHOD.md` §11.5A); the **Msg-replay test** is the discipline check. The realization stack is the project's choice, recorded in the design module along with justification of model preservation. The method tests realizations against §4–§10 and the §14 failure patterns; it does not rank stacks, languages, or frameworks.

field_semantics.bounded_author_binding: Author represented an identified predicate, applicability, obligations and latitude with typed owner/dependency/result/argument bindings; not an independent completeness judgment.
field_semantics.source_carried_clause: Exact available source and paragraph spans with a source excerpt; representation_kind and interpretation_standing distinguish definitions, pending conditions, consumers and non-deciding locators. This is not completed semantic interpretation.
field_semantics.source_clauses: Exact byte spans and hashes reacquire blocks. Diagnostic lines and lexical roles are hints; they establish neither modal force nor semantic sufficiency.
field_semantics.dependencies: String determination IDs for authored contract dependencies only. Source links and scope are typed separately in dependency_relations.
field_semantics.argument: Adopted premises, conditional support and extra policy remain distinct. A source argument route is not an independently proved entailment.
field_semantics.result_mapping: Domain data and decisions are not verdict aliases. Instance evidence must bind the exact claimed predicate, actual performance, effects, authority and required coverage.
field_semantics.empty_fields: An empty extraction is not proof of no source duty, exception or result map.
field_semantics.predicate: Null for a definition/data row or a non-deciding locator means no assessment predicate is asserted. Null for construction_pending means the available source still requires authored decomposition, not missing source or an indeterminate domain verdict.
field_semantics.representation_kind: constraint, definition_data, consumer_binding or non_deciding_locator; this partitions work, not independent law counts. Definition bodies can contain embedded constraints, named in their remaining work.
field_semantics.owner: path resolves the single source_members pin; anchor and body_sha256 identify the exact heading body. Lines are diagnostic.
field_semantics.clause_id: A local cN in a row resolves to that row ID plus #cN. Source byte spans and SHA-256 authenticate the precise quoted block; no whole-source duplication.
field_semantics.applicability_ref: Resolve owner_families[path].applicability; local applicability overrides only this row.
field_semantics.consumers: Stable determination IDs, inverse of the authored dependencies list; exact owner is recovered from the referenced row.
field_semantics.remaining_work_ref: Resolve remaining_work_contracts by representation kind; per-owner ID partition enumerates the concrete unfinished units.
field_semantics.result_account_contracts: Shared accounting states, not a new result codomain. Local result-clause references preserve the unclassified source conditions.
field_semantics.package_projection: Construction/history/reduction/baseline/review/coverage planning is evidence outside the product. A semantic projection selects only justified definitions, predicates, obligations, latitude, typed dependency/scope, result and argument fields, with source references and explicit unresolved scope.

model.shared_result_contracts.core_resul.scope: Apply to the exact local claim below, not to its definition/data value. Every result retains subject/basis, original domain outcome and reason, performance, evidence, absent coverage and material effects.
model.shared_result_contracts.core_resul.satisfied: Admissible evidence establishes this local predicate and all its required joins/coverage under its rule; evaluation is performed.
model.shared_result_contracts.core_resul.falsified: Admissible counterevidence defeats this local predicate; separately missing coverage remains exposed.
model.shared_result_contracts.core_resul.indeterminate: Decisive support, reason or applicability remains missing; unperformed/unconfirmed evaluation cannot satisfy.
model.shared_result_contracts.core_resul.invalid_basis: This claim has an uninterpretable/invalid subject, governing basis or required interpretation.
model.shared_result_contracts.core_resul.out_of_frame: Established scope/capability shortfall on this claim; wider obligation remains visible.
model.shared_result_contracts.core_resul.conjunction: For an interpretable aggregate, authenticated applicable falsification dominates other unknown coverage, then invalid required basis, then required out_of_frame, then unresolved/missing coverage; only established complete satisfaction satisfies.
model.shared_result_contracts.core_resul.effects: Typed domain outcomes retain observations and reason. Lost acknowledgment after possible effects is unknown, not no effect. Replay correctness is not effect completion.
model.shared_result_contracts.core_resul.nonclaims: Author construction only: no evidence that a real consumer instance satisfies these predicates.
